historicalBaseline.label: gold-v1-pre-optimization
historicalBaseline.note: Recorded before resolver changes; provisional diagnostic only, not an A/B or human-verified result.

humanReviewPlan.note: Current labels are assistant drafts; do not claim human accuracy or release eligibility before independent review and adjudication.

limitations: Labels are not independently human reviewed; this is a provisional routing baseline, not human accuracy.
mode=rule evaluates the deterministic production pre-router with allow_llm=false, not the full HTTP Agent conversation.
The four metrics do not establish customer satisfaction, FCR, CSAT, production volume, or business conversion.

criticalHandoffMissRate.definition: Severe漏转人工率 among gold handoffSeverity=CRITICAL cases; lower is better.
criticalHandoffMissRate.name: criticalHandoffMissRate

handoffRecall.definition: Among gold shouldHandoff=true cases, only next_action=HANDOFF counts as immediate handoff; HANDOFF_SUGGESTED does not.
handoffRecall.name: handoffRecall

highRiskIntentRecall.definition: Recall of cases independently labelled riskLevel=HIGH, requiring predicted riskLevel=HIGH.
highRiskIntentRecall.name: highRiskIntentRecall

intentMacroF1.definition: Gold intent labels are macro-averaged across the observed label set; prediction outside the set is counted as a miss/false positive.
intentMacroF1.name: intentMacroF1

slotEntitySpanF1.definition: Micro character-span F1 over expected and predicted structured entity values; extra predicted fields count as false positives.
slotEntitySpanF1.name: slotEntitySpanF1

slotExactMatch.definition: Request-level exact equality of all expected slots; cases with no expected slots are excluded from the denominator.
slotExactMatch.name: slotExactMatch
